rows.en: Learning objectives
rows.ne: सिकाइका उद्देश्यहरू
rows.bt: Learning objectives
rows.note: Glossary proposal: learning objectives = सिकाइका उद्देश्यहरू.

rows.en: This manual includes the material needed to deliver a workshop or series of workshops on using the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) Minimum Service Package (MSP) to strengthen MHPSS in humanitarian programming.
rows.ne: मानवीय कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS सुदृढ गर्न मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS) न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) को प्रयोगबारे कार्यशाला वा कार्यशालाहरूको शृङ्खला सञ्चालन गर्न आवश्यक सामग्री यस पुस्तिकामा समावेश छ।
rows.bt: This manual includes the materials needed to conduct a workshop or a series of workshops on the use of the mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) Minimum Service Package (MSP) to strengthen MHPSS in humanitarian programme planning and implementation.
rows.note: Glossary proposal: workshop = कार्यशाला. T001 is reused verbatim as a supplied unreviewed candidate; this is a description of workshop materials.

rows.en: The modules included in this manual are designed to strengthen the capacity of humanitarian actors to integrate MHPSS into programming across different sectors and areas of work.
rows.ne: यस पुस्तिकामा समावेश मोड्युलहरू विभिन्न क्षेत्र र कार्यक्षेत्रमा कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने गरी तयार गरिएका छन्।
rows.bt: The modules included in this manual have been prepared to strengthen the capacity of actors involved in humanitarian work to integrate MHPSS into programme planning and implementation in different sectors and areas of work.
rows.note: Glossary proposal: module = मोड्युल.

rows.en: The workshop provides participants with the opportunity to build the knowledge, attitudes, and skills needed to be able to use the MSP to:
rows.ne: कार्यशालाले सहभागीहरूलाई MSP प्रयोग गरी निम्न कार्य गर्न आवश्यक ज्ञान, दृष्टिकोण र सीप विकास गर्ने अवसर प्रदान गर्दछ।
rows.bt: The workshop provides participants with an opportunity to develop the knowledge, attitudes and skills needed to do the following using the MSP.
rows.note: Glossary proposals: workshop = कार्यशाला; participants = सहभागीहरू. The sentence introduces the following four bullets.

rows.en: • Improve coordination of MHPSS within and between sectors
rows.ne: • क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS को समन्वयमा सुधार गर्ने।
rows.bt: • Improve coordination of MHPSS within and between sectors.
rows.note: Glossary proposal: coordination = समन्वय. This learning objective is not the exact activity-list title.

rows.en: • Strengthen advocacy for MHPSS
rows.ne: • MHPSS का लागि पैरवी सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: • Strengthen advocacy for MHPSS.

rows.en: • Design high-quality MHPSS programmes or improve existing programming
rows.ne: • उच्च गुणस्तरका MHPSS कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन गर्ने वा विद्यमान कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा सुधार गर्ने।
rows.bt: • Design high-quality MHPSS programmes or improve existing programme planning and implementation.

rows.en: • Effectively plan and budget for MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: • MHPSS गतिविधिहरूका लागि प्रभावकारी रूपमा योजना र बजेट तयार गर्ने।
rows.bt: • Effectively prepare plans and budgets for MHPSS activities.

rows.en: The learning objectives and corresponding modules should be tailored to the specific context and needs of targeted participants.
rows.ne: सिकाइका उद्देश्यहरू र तिनसँग सम्बन्धित मोड्युलहरू लक्षित सहभागीहरूको विशिष्ट सन्दर्भ र आवश्यकताअनुसार अनुकूलित गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: It is appropriate to adapt the learning objectives and their related modules according to the specific context and needs of the target participants.
rows.note: Glossary proposals: learning objectives = सिकाइका उद्देश्यहरू; module = मोड्युल; participants = सहभागीहरू. The back-translation strengthens the source recommendation 'should be tailored' to the requirement 'must be adapted'. The revision restores recommendation strength while retaining the specific context and needs of targeted participants.

rows.en: Participants
rows.ne: सहभागीहरू
rows.bt: Participants
rows.note: Glossary proposal: participants = सहभागीहरू.

rows.en: The workshop is designed for humanitarian actors engaged in MHPSS programming in any sector/cluster/area of responsibility (AoR).
rows.ne: यो कार्यशाला कुनै पनि क्षेत्र/क्लस्टर/जिम्मेवारी क्षेत्र (AoR) मा MHPSS सम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा संलग्न मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूका लागि तयार गरिएको हो।
rows.bt: This workshop has been prepared for actors involved in humanitarian work who are involved in MHPSS-related programme planning and implementation in any sector/cluster/area of responsibility (AoR).
rows.note: Glossary proposal: workshop = कार्यशाला. AoR is preserved exactly.

rows.en: The content is not intended as a foundational training on MHPSS and does not equip participants to implement a specific MHPSS activity or intervention.
rows.ne: यो विषयवस्तु MHPSS सम्बन्धी आधारभूत तालिमका रूपमा तयार गरिएको होइन र यसले सहभागीहरूलाई कुनै निश्चित MHPSS गतिविधि वा हस्तक्षेप कार्यान्वयन गर्न सक्षम बनाउँदैन।
rows.bt: This content has not been prepared as basic training on MHPSS and does not enable participants to implement any specific MHPSS activity or intervention.
rows.note: Glossary proposal: participants = सहभागीहरू. Intervention is used here in the general programme sense; no specific clinical intervention or clinical wording is introduced. The limitation on participant competence is retained.

rows.en: Although the first module provides a brief overview of the field of MHPSS, the focus of this manual is on equipping users to navigate and use the MSP.
rows.ne: पहिलो मोड्युलले MHPSS क्षेत्रको संक्षिप्त झलक दिए पनि यस पुस्तिकाको मुख्य जोड प्रयोगकर्ताहरूलाई MSP मा आवश्यक जानकारी खोज्न र MSP प्रयोग गर्न सक्षम बनाउनु हो।
rows.bt: Although the first module gives a brief overview of the MHPSS field, the main emphasis of this manual is to enable users to find the information needed in the MSP and to use the MSP.
rows.note: Glossary proposal: module = मोड्युल. Navigating refers to locating information within the MSP, not implementing a clinical intervention.

rows.en: Participants are therefore assumed to have a basic understanding of the field of MHPSS, but they do not need to have extensive technical expertise in MHPSS to benefit from the workshop.
rows.ne: त्यसैले सहभागीहरूलाई MHPSS कार्यक्षेत्रको आधारभूत बुझाइ भएको मानिन्छ, तर कार्यशालाबाट लाभ लिन उनीहरूसँग MHPSS सम्बन्धी व्यापक प्राविधिक विशेषज्ञता हुनु आवश्यक छैन।
rows.bt: Therefore, participants are assumed to have a basic understanding of the MHPSS field of work, but they do not need to have extensive technical expertise in MHPSS to benefit from the workshop.

rows.en: The workshop modules may be delivered to a multi-sectoral audience, bringing together actors from multiple sectors, or to participants from a single area of work (e.g. a particular sector, cluster, or AOR).
rows.ne: कार्यशालाका मोड्युलहरू विभिन्न क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूलाई एकसाथ सहभागी गराएर बहुक्षेत्रीय सहभागी समूहका लागि वा एउटै कार्यक्षेत्रका सहभागीहरूका लागि (जस्तै, कुनै निश्चित क्षेत्र, क्लस्टर वा AOR) सञ्चालन गर्न सकिन्छ।
rows.bt: The workshop modules can be conducted for a multisectoral participant group by bringing together stakeholders from different sectors, or for participants from the same field of work (for example, a particular sector, cluster or AOR).
rows.note: The recurring term 'module' is absent from G-0.3; proposed wording is listed separately. AOR is retained without expansion.

rows.en: If the participants are drawn from a common area of work, the facilitator should adapt the materials accordingly (for example, by using sector-specific examples and case scenarios) while still emphasizing the importance of coordinating across sectors/clusters/AORs.
rows.ne: यदि सहभागीहरू एउटै कार्यक्षेत्रबाट आएका छन् भने सहजकर्ताले क्षेत्र/क्लस्टर/AORs बीच समन्वय गर्नुको महत्त्वमा जोड दिँदै सामग्रीलाई तदनुसार अनुकूलन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ (उदाहरणका लागि, क्षेत्रविशेषका उदाहरण र घटनामा आधारित परिदृश्यहरू प्रयोग गरेर)।
rows.bt: If participants come from the same sector of work, it would be appropriate for the facilitator to adapt the material accordingly, emphasizing the importance of coordination among sectors/clusters/AORs (for example, by using sector-specific examples and incident-based scenarios).
rows.note: The source form AORs is retained exactly. The translation strengthens 'should adapt' to 'must adapt'; the revision restores a recommendation while retaining the condition and cross-sector coordination emphasis. The back-translation narrows a common area of work to the same sector of work and changes case scenarios to incident-based scenarios.

rows.en: Workshops on the MSP should ideally be organized through an MHPSS Technical Working Group (TWG) where one exists.
rows.ne: जहाँ MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (TWG) छ, त्यहाँ आदर्श रूपमा MSP सम्बन्धी कार्यशालाहरू सोही कार्यसमूहमार्फत आयोजना गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Where there is an MHPSS Technical Working Group (TWG), ideally it would be appropriate to organize workshops on MSP through that same working group.
rows.note: The source expresses an ideal recommendation, not a requirement qualified by feasibility. The revision restores 'should ideally' and retains the condition that a TWG exists.

rows.en: Facilitators
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्ता
rows.bt: Facilitator

rows.en: Facilitators should have MHPSS technical expertise, including experience in integrating MHPSS within one or more sectors/ clusters/AoRs.
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्तासँग एक वा बढी क्षेत्र/क्लस्टर/AoRs भित्र MHPSS एकीकृत गरेको अनुभवसहित MHPSS सम्बन्धी प्राविधिक विशेषज्ञता हुनु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: It would be appropriate for the facilitator to have technical expertise in MHPSS, including experience integrating MHPSS within one or more sectors/clusters/AoRs.
rows.note: The source form AoRs is retained exactly. The translation strengthens 'should have' to 'must have'; the revision restores the source's recommendation.

rows.en: They should be competent users of the MSP, having thoroughly read and understood all sections of the MSP such that they are able to:
rows.ne: MSP का सबै खण्ड राम्ररी पढेर बुझेका उनीहरू MSP का सक्षम प्रयोगकर्ता हुनु उचित हुन्छ, ताकि उनीहरूले निम्न कार्य गर्न सकून्:
rows.bt: It would be appropriate for them to be competent users of MSP, having thoroughly read and understood all sections of MSP, so that they can do the following:
rows.note: The translation turns 'should' into two mandatory requirements. The revision restores the recommendation and preserves thorough reading and understanding of every section as the basis for the listed abilities.

rows.en: • Differentiate between sections of the MSP
rows.ne: • MSP का खण्डहरूबीचको भिन्नता छुट्याउने।
rows.bt: • Distinguish between the sections of the MSP.

rows.en: • Name and give examples of specific MSP activities
rows.ne: • निश्चित MSP गतिविधिहरूको नाम बताउने र उदाहरण दिने।
rows.bt: • Name specific MSP activities and give examples.

rows.en: • Explain the value of the checklists of actions
rows.ne: • गर्नुपर्ने कार्यहरूका जाँचसूचीको महत्त्व व्याख्या गर्ने।
rows.bt: • Explain the importance of checklists of tasks to be done.

rows.en: • Find and explain key considerations
rows.ne: • मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षहरू खोज्ने र तिनको व्याख्या गर्ने।
rows.bt: • Find the main aspects to be considered and explain them.

rows.en: • Be familiar with the MSP Gap Analysis and MSP Costing Tool
rows.ne: • MSP Gap Analysis र MSP लागत अनुमान उपकरणसँग परिचित हुने।
rows.bt: • Become familiar with the MSP Gap Analysis and the MSP cost estimation tool.
rows.note: MSP Gap Analysis has no supplied glossary entry. Its English title is retained alongside proposed Nepali wording for review. The added Nepali gloss interprets MSP Gap Analysis as analysis of gaps within the MSP itself, which the source title does not establish. The revision retains the exact English title without that interpretation; its technical meaning and Nepali terminology remain pending review. The back-translation changes being familiar with the tools, an existing competency, to becoming familiar with them, a process of acquiring that competency.

rows.en: • Find and explain the at-risk groups section
rows.ne: • जोखिममा रहेका समूहहरूसम्बन्धी खण्ड खोज्ने र त्यसको व्याख्या गर्ने।
rows.bt: • Find the section concerning groups at risk and explain it.

rows.en: • Find and explain the infectious diseases section
rows.ne: • सरुवा रोगसम्बन्धी खण्ड खोज्नुहोस् र त्यसको व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Find the section on communicable diseases and explain it.
rows.note: The frozen form सरुवा रोग denotes communicable diseases and may exclude infectious diseases that are not transmissible between hosts, so it may narrow the source scope and requires terminology review. bt-divergence: Frozen T242 denotes communicable diseases, potentially excluding infectious diseases that are not transmissible between hosts. The frozen form is retained unchanged; the source scope conflict remains unresolved.

rows.en: Facilitators should be proficient in navigating the online MSP platform, including being able to:
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्ता अनलाइन MSP मञ्चका विभिन्न भागमा जान दक्ष हुनु उचित हुन्छ, जसमा निम्न कार्य गर्न सक्ने क्षमता समावेश छ:
rows.bt: It would be appropriate for the facilitator to be skilled at navigating the different parts of the online MSP platform, including the ability to do the following:
rows.note: The translation strengthens 'should' to 'must' and substitutes finding and using necessary materials and features for navigating the platform. The revision restores the recommendation and the navigation focus.

rows.en: • Filter activities by sector
rows.ne: • क्षेत्रअनुसार गतिविधिहरू छानेर देखाउने।
rows.bt: • Select and display activities by sector.

rows.en: • Use the search function
rows.ne: • खोजी सुविधा प्रयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: • Use the search feature.

rows.en: • Find relevant guidelines, standards, and tools for specific MSP activities
rows.ne: • निश्चित MSP गतिविधिहरूका लागि सान्दर्भिक निर्देशिकाहरू, मापदण्डहरू र उपकरणहरू खोज्ने।
rows.bt: • Find relevant guidelines, standards and tools for specific MSP activities.

rows.en: Facilitators should select modules, and adapt the content and exercises within the modules, according to the training needs and experience of participants.
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्ताले सहभागीहरूको तालिमसम्बन्धी आवश्यकता र अनुभवअनुसार मोड्युलहरू छनोट गर्नु र ती मोड्युलभित्रका विषयवस्तु तथा अभ्यासहरू अनुकूलन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: It is appropriate for the facilitator to select modules according to the participants' training-related needs and experience and to adapt the content and exercises within those modules.
rows.note: Uses the separate proposal for the recurring term 'module'. The source recommends both actions with 'should'; the Nepali and back-translation strengthen both to 'must'. The revision expresses a recommendation rather than a requirement.

rows.en: For instance, Modules 1 and 2, which provide a basic overview of MHPSS, may be important for participants with little or no technical background in MHPSS, but may not be necessary for an audience of MHPSS technical specialists.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, MHPSS को आधारभूत झलक प्रस्तुत गर्ने मोड्युल 1 र 2, MHPSS मा प्राविधिक पृष्ठभूमि थोरै भएका वा हुँदै नभएका सहभागीहरूका लागि महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन सक्छन्, तर MHPSS का प्राविधिक विशेषज्ञहरूका लागि आवश्यक नहुन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, modules 1 and 2, which present a basic overview of MHPSS, may be important for participants with little or no technical background in MHPSS, but may not be necessary for technical experts in MHPSS.
rows.note: Uses the separate proposal for the recurring term 'module'; this is ordinary training guidance rather than clinical content.

rows.en: Annex 1- Delivery Modalities of the Workshop provides direction on how to select modules for different audiences.
rows.ne: अनुसूची 1- कार्यशाला सञ्चालनका विधिहरूले विभिन्न सहभागी समूहका लागि मोड्युलहरू कसरी छनोट गर्ने भन्ने मार्गदर्शन दिन्छ।
rows.bt: Annex 1 - Methods for conducting workshops provides guidance on how to select modules for different participant groups.
rows.note: Uses the separate proposal for the recurring term 'module'.

rows.en: To deliver the eight core modules as laid out in this manual, it is recommended to plan for a three-day workshop.
rows.ne: यस पुस्तिकामा उल्लेख गरिएअनुसार आठ मुख्य मोड्युल सञ्चालन गर्न तीन दिने कार्यशालाको योजना बनाउन सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: It is recommended to plan a three-day workshop to conduct the eight main modules as described in this manual.
rows.note: Uses the separate proposal for the recurring term 'module'.

rows.en: A sample agenda for a three-day workshop is included in Annex 2 - Sample Agenda for a 3-Day Workshop.
rows.ne: तीन दिने कार्यशालाको नमुना कार्यसूची अनुसूची 2 - 3 दिने कार्यशालाको नमुना कार्यसूचीमा समावेश गरिएको छ।
rows.bt: A sample agenda for a three-day workshop is included in Annex 2 - Sample agenda for a 3-day workshop.

rows.en: Certain modules, and exercises within the modules, may be used for stand-alone sessions.
rows.ne: केही मोड्युल र ती मोड्युलभित्रका अभ्यासहरू छुट्टै सत्रका लागि प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ।
rows.bt: Some modules and the exercises within those modules can be used for separate sessions.
rows.note: Uses the separate proposal for the recurring term 'module'.

rows.en: For example, facilitators can use the workshop as an opportunity to support an MSP Gap Analysis exercise by facilitating Module 6 on MHPSS Programme Activities, followed by an MSP Gap Analysis exercise.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, सहजीकरणकर्ताले MHPSS कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरूसम्बन्धी मोड्युल 6 को सहजीकरण गरेपछि MSP सम्बन्धी कमीको विश्लेषण गर्ने अभ्यास सञ्चालन गरेर उक्त अभ्यासमा सहयोग पुर्‍याउने अवसरका रूपमा कार्यशालालाई प्रयोग गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, after facilitating module 6 on MHPSS programmatic activities, the facilitator can conduct an exercise to analyse gaps related to the MSP and use the workshop as an opportunity to support that exercise.
rows.note: The sequence is retained: Module 6 first, then the MSP Gap Analysis exercise. Proposals for 'module' and 'MSP Gap Analysis' are listed separately.

rows.en: The additional module on the MSP Costing Tool can be delivered following the three-day workshop, as part of a refresher training or a webinar following the standard MSP workshop.
rows.ne: MSP लागत अनुमान उपकरणसम्बन्धी थप मोड्युल तीन दिने कार्यशालापछि, मानक MSP कार्यशालापछि हुने पुनर्ताजगी तालिम वा वेबिनारको अङ्गका रूपमा सञ्चालन गर्न सकिन्छ।
rows.bt: The additional module concerning the MSP cost estimation tool can be conducted after the three-day workshop, as part of refresher training or a webinar that takes place after the standard MSP workshop.
rows.note: Uses the separate proposal for the recurring term 'module'. The source specifies the 'standard MSP workshop'; नियमित and the back-translation 'regular' can instead imply a routine or recurring workshop. Replaced नियमित with मानक to preserve 'standard'.

rows.en: Adaptation to context and participants
rows.ne: सन्दर्भ र सहभागीहरूअनुसार अनुकूलन
rows.bt: Adaptation according to the context and participants

rows.en: The exercises, discussions, questions, and points throughout the manual are designed to provide guidance to the facilitators.
rows.ne: यस पुस्तिकाभरि रहेका अभ्यास, छलफल, प्रश्न र बुँदाहरू सहजीकरणकर्तालाई मार्गदर्शन प्रदान गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार गरिएका छन्।
rows.bt: The exercises, discussions, questions and points throughout this manual have been prepared with the aim of providing guidance to the facilitator.

rows.en: Facilitators are encouraged to use their own language and examples to support the learning objectives in each module, rather than following the text as a verbatim script.
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्तालाई पाठलाई शब्दशः पढेर सुनाउने पटकथाका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्नुको सट्टा प्रत्येक मोड्युलका सिकाइ उद्देश्य हासिल गर्न सहयोग पुग्ने गरी आफ्नै भाषा र उदाहरणहरू प्रयोग गर्न प्रोत्साहित गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: The facilitator is encouraged to use their own language and examples in a way that helps achieve the learning objectives of each module, rather than using the text as a script to read aloud word for word.
rows.note: Recurring terms 'module' and 'learning objectives' are absent from G-0.3; proposed renderings are listed for review.

rows.en: In particular, facilitators are encouraged to contextualize the workshop to the specific setting and participants by using examples and scenarios relevant to the context wherever possible, and by taking into account local knowledge, experience, and practices as much as possible.
rows.ne: विशेष गरी, सहजीकरणकर्तालाई सम्भव भएसम्म सन्दर्भसँग सम्बन्धित उदाहरण र परिस्थितिहरू प्रयोग गरेर तथा स्थानीय ज्ञान, अनुभव र अभ्यासलाई सकेसम्म ध्यानमा राखेर कार्यशालालाई विशिष्ट परिवेश र सहभागीहरूअनुकूल बनाउन प्रोत्साहित गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: In particular, the facilitator is encouraged to adapt the workshop to the specific setting and participants by using context-related examples and situations wherever possible and taking local knowledge, experience and practices into account as much as possible.

rows.en: It is important to review and adapt activities and case scenarios in advance to ensure they are appropriate to the context.
rows.ne: गतिविधि र घटनामा आधारित परिस्थितिहरू सन्दर्भअनुकूल छन् भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्न तिनको अग्रिम समीक्षा र अनुकूलन गर्नु महत्त्वपूर्ण छ।
rows.bt: It is important to review and adapt the activities and event-based situations in advance to ensure that they are appropriate to the context.
rows.note: General guidance on reviewing contextual suitability; safety review pending.

rows.en: Given varying conflict-related, cultural, and political sensitivities from location to location, a scenario that is appropriate in one context may create risks or tensions between participants in another.
rows.ne: द्वन्द्वसम्बन्धी, सांस्कृतिक र राजनीतिक संवेदनशीलता स्थानअनुसार फरक हुने भएकाले एउटा सन्दर्भमा उपयुक्त हुने परिस्थितिले अर्को सन्दर्भमा सहभागीहरूबीच जोखिम वा तनाव उत्पन्न गर्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: Because conflict-related, cultural and political sensitivities vary by location, a situation that is appropriate in one context may create risks or tensions among participants in another context.
rows.note: Describes context-dependent risks and tensions between participants, not clinical symptoms; safety review pending.

rows.en: Careful review and adaptation by a local facilitator is therefore critical.
rows.ne: त्यसैले स्थानीय सहजकर्ताले सावधानीपूर्वक समीक्षा र अनुकूलन गर्नु अत्यावश्यक छ।
rows.bt: Therefore, careful review and adaptation by a local facilitator are essential.
rows.note: General guidance on local review and adaptation; safety review pending.

rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering of 'online facilitation', which is absent from G-0.3.

rows.en: To avoid participants becoming fatigued, it is recommended that online workshops be spread across multiple half-days, rather than delivered over full days.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूलाई थकित हुनबाट जोगाउन अनलाइन कार्यशालाहरू पूरा दिनभरि सञ्चालन गर्नुको सट्टा धेरै दिनमा आधा-आधा दिन गरी सञ्चालन गर्न सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: To prevent participants from becoming tired, it is recommended that online workshops be conducted in half-day sessions over several days rather than for a full day.

rows.en: Given that the workshop methodology is based on participatory exercises and discussions, which entail many instances where breakout rooms are needed, it is highly recommended to:
rows.ne: कार्यशालाको विधि सहभागितामूलक अभ्यास र छलफलमा आधारित हुने र यस क्रममा धेरै पटक ब्रेकआउट कक्ष आवश्यक पर्ने भएकाले निम्न कार्य गर्न जोड दिएर सिफारिस गरिन्छ:
rows.bt: As the workshop method will be based on participatory exercises and discussion, and breakout rooms will be needed many times during this process, it is strongly recommended to do the following:
rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering of 'breakout rooms', which is absent from G-0.3. The back-translation says 'particularly recommended', which does not explicitly retain the strength of 'highly recommended'. The revision makes the emphasis on recommendation explicit.

rows.en: • Use an online platform that allows ‘breakout rooms’, ‘broadcast communication’ to allow communication with all breakout rooms simultaneously, and a ‘virtual white board’.
rows.ne: • ‘ब्रेकआउट कक्ष’, सबै ब्रेकआउट कक्षसँग एकैसाथ सञ्चार गर्न मिल्ने ‘प्रसारण सञ्चार’ (broadcast communication) र ‘भर्चुअल ह्वाइटबोर्ड’ (virtual white board) को सुविधा भएको अनलाइन मञ्च प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Use an online platform with facilities for ‘breakout rooms’, ‘broadcast communication’ (broadcast communication) that allows communication with all breakout rooms at once, and a ‘virtual whiteboard’ (virtual white board).
rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering of 'breakout rooms', which is absent from G-0.3. English interface terms are retained to clarify the required platform functions.

rows.en: • Have no more than 25 people per online workshop.
rows.ne: • प्रत्येक अनलाइन कार्यशालामा 25 जनाभन्दा बढी नराख्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Do not have more than 25 people in each online workshop.

rows.en: • Have a co-facilitator who can support with creating breakout rooms, sharing links to handouts, and checking in with participants while they are in breakout rooms to answer their questions and ensure they have understood the instructions of the learning activity.
rows.ne: • ब्रेकआउट कक्ष बनाउने, वितरण सामग्रीका लिङ्क साझा गर्ने र सहभागीहरू ब्रेकआउट कक्षमा हुँदा उनीहरूसँग सम्पर्क गरी उनीहरूका प्रश्नको उत्तर दिने तथा उनीहरूले सिकाइ गतिविधिका निर्देशन बुझेको सुनिश्चित गर्ने काममा सहयोग गर्न सक्ने सह-सहजकर्ता राख्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Have a co-facilitator who can help with creating breakout rooms, sharing links to handouts, and contacting participants while they are in breakout rooms to answer their questions and ensure that they have understood the instructions for the learning activities.
rows.note: Uses proposed renderings of 'breakout rooms' and 'co-facilitator', which are absent from G-0.3. The supplied facilitator form is retained within the compound.

rows.en: • When creating the groups, ask them to choose a spokesperson, a person facilitating the discussion and a person taking notes. If you observe that it tends to be the same people presenting each time, assign different participants to that role in the next exercises.
rows.ne: • समूहहरू बनाउँदा उनीहरूलाई एक जना प्रवक्ता, एक जना छलफल सहजीकरण गर्ने व्यक्ति र एक जना टिपोट गर्ने व्यक्ति छान्न लगाउनुहोस्। हरेक पटक उही व्यक्तिहरूले प्रस्तुति दिने प्रवृत्ति देख्नुभयो भने त्यसपछिका अभ्यासमा उक्त भूमिकाका लागि फरक सहभागीहरू तोक्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • When forming groups, have them choose one spokesperson, one person to facilitate the discussion and one person to take notes. If you notice a tendency for the same people to present every time, assign different participants to that role in subsequent exercises.

rows.en: For hybrid workshops, e.g., where participants will be together in-person, but the main facilitator will be presenting remotely via video-conferencing, a co-facilitator who will be physically present with participants should be identified in advance.
rows.ne: मिश्रित ढाँचाका कार्यशालाहरूका लागि, उदाहरणका लागि सहभागीहरू एकै ठाउँमा प्रत्यक्ष उपस्थित हुने तर मुख्य सहजकर्ताले भिडियो कन्फरेन्सिङमार्फत टाढाबाट प्रस्तुति दिने अवस्थामा, सहभागीहरूसँग भौतिक रूपमा उपस्थित रहने सह-सहजकर्ता पहिल्यै पहिचान गर्न सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: For mixed-format workshops, for example, when participants are present in person in one place but the main facilitator gives a presentation remotely through video conferencing, it is recommended to identify in advance a co-facilitator who will be physically present with the participants.
rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering of 'co-facilitator', which is absent from G-0.3. The back-translation strengthens 'should be identified' to 'must be identified'. The revision expresses a recommendation while retaining advance identification and physical presence with participants.

rows.en: The co-facilitator should be briefed on the different exercises so they can support with co-facilitation of the workshop.
rows.ne: सह-सहजकर्ताले कार्यशालाको सह-सहजीकरणमा सहयोग गर्न सकून् भनेर उनलाई विभिन्न अभ्यासबारे संक्षिप्त जानकारी दिन सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: It is recommended to give the co-facilitator brief information about the various exercises so that they can help with co-facilitating the workshop.
rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering of 'co-facilitator', which is absent from G-0.3. The back-translation strengthens 'should be briefed' to 'must be given brief information'. The revision restores recommendation rather than obligation.

rows.en: Learning methodology and activities
rows.ne: सिकाइ विधि र गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: Learning methods and activities

rows.en: The manual outlines a training approach that is participatory and inclusive.
rows.ne: यस पुस्तिकाले सहभागितामूलक र समावेशी तालिम पद्धतिको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
rows.bt: This manual presents an outline of a participatory and inclusive training approach.

rows.en: It includes presentations, group work, individual work, and practice exercises designed to build on the capacity and experience of the participants.
rows.ne: यसमा सहभागीहरूको विद्यमान क्षमता र अनुभवलाई आधार बनाएर थप विकास गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार गरिएका प्रस्तुति, समूहगत कार्य, व्यक्तिगत कार्य र अभ्यासहरू समावेश छन्।
rows.bt: It includes presentations, group work, individual work and exercises prepared with the aim of building on and further developing participants’ existing abilities and experience.

rows.en: Facilitators should approach training in a flexible manner, adapting to the participants needs and capacities, and ensuring an interactive, participatory approach.
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्ताले सहभागीहरूको आवश्यकता र क्षमताअनुसार अनुकूलन गर्दै तथा अन्तरक्रियात्मक र सहभागितामूलक पद्धति सुनिश्चित गर्दै लचिलो ढङ्गले तालिम सञ्चालन गर्न सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: It is recommended that the facilitator conduct the training flexibly, adapting according to the participants' needs and abilities and ensuring an interactive and participatory approach.
rows.note: The back-translation strengthens 'should approach training' to 'must conduct the training'. The revision restores recommendation and retains flexibility, adaptation to participants, and the interactive, participatory approach. The source refers to facilitators in the plural, whereas the back-translation refers to a singular facilitator.

rows.en: Training should be culturally appropriate, age- and gender-sensitive, and inclusive of people living with disabilities.
rows.ne: तालिमलाई सांस्कृतिक रूपमा उपयुक्त, उमेर र लैङ्गिक पक्षप्रति संवेदनशील तथा अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्तिहरूलाई समावेश गर्ने बनाउन सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: It is recommended to make the training culturally appropriate, sensitive to age and gender aspects, and inclusive of persons with disabilities.
rows.note: The back-translation strengthens 'should be' to 'must be'. The revision expresses recommendation while retaining cultural appropriateness, age and gender sensitivity, and disability inclusion.

rows.en: This manual includes different learning methodologies, identified by boxes with different colors and icons.
rows.ne: यस पुस्तिकामा विभिन्न सिकाइ विधिहरू समावेश छन्, जसलाई फरक रङ र चिह्नहरू भएका बाकसद्वारा चिनाइएको छ।
rows.bt: This manual includes various learning methods, which are marked by boxes with different colours and symbols.

rows.en: These boxes contain the learning objectives that are expected to be achieved during the module.
rows.ne: यी बाकसहरूमा मोड्युलका क्रममा हासिल हुने अपेक्षा गरिएका सिकाइ उद्देश्यहरू समावेश छन्।
rows.bt: These boxes contain the learning objectives expected to be achieved during the module.
rows.note: Uses proposed renderings of 'module' and 'learning objectives', which are absent from G-0.3.

rows.en: It is recommended that facilitators present the module learning objectives on a slide or flip chart at the beginning of the module and review them again at the end of the module.
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्ताले मोड्युलको सुरुमा त्यसका सिकाइ उद्देश्यहरू स्लाइड वा फ्लिप चार्टमा प्रस्तुत गर्न र मोड्युलको अन्त्यमा तिनको पुनः समीक्षा गर्न सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: It is recommended that the facilitator present the module’s learning objectives on slides or a flip chart at the beginning of the module and review them again at the end of the module.
rows.note: Uses proposed renderings of 'module' and 'learning objectives', which are absent from G-0.3.

rows.en: Presenting the learning objectives in this manner helps participants to have a clear understanding of what they can expect to learn during the module and allows facilitators and participants to check whether those objectives have been achieved at the end of the module.
rows.ne: यसरी सिकाइ उद्देश्यहरू प्रस्तुत गर्दा सहभागीहरूलाई मोड्युलका क्रममा के सिक्ने अपेक्षा गर्न सकिन्छ भन्ने स्पष्ट रूपमा बुझ्न मद्दत पुग्छ र सहजीकरणकर्ता तथा सहभागीहरूले मोड्युलको अन्त्यमा ती उद्देश्यहरू हासिल भए वा भएनन् भनी जाँच गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: Presenting the learning objectives in this way helps participants clearly understand what they can expect to learn during the module, and the facilitator and participants can check at the end of the module whether or not those objectives have been achieved.
rows.note: Uses proposed renderings of 'module' and 'learning objectives', which are absent from G-0.3.

rows.en: Facilitators can use the review of learning objectives at the end of each module to identify topics that need more attention during the workshop.
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्ताले प्रत्येक मोड्युलको अन्त्यमा सिकाइ उद्देश्यहरूको समीक्षा गरेर कार्यशालाका क्रममा थप ध्यान दिनुपर्ने विषयहरू पहिचान गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: By reviewing the learning objectives at the end of each module, the facilitator can identify topics that need further attention during the workshop.
rows.note: Uses proposed renderings of 'module' and 'learning objectives', which are absent from G-0.3.

rows.bt: These entries include questions that the facilitator can ask the group to move the discussion forward.

rows.en: These are thumbnail versions of slides that trainers can use to communicate the points in the cell on the right-hand side.
rows.ne: यी स्लाइडका लघुचित्रहरू हुन्, जसलाई प्रशिक्षकहरूले दायाँपट्टिको कोष्ठमा भएका बुँदाहरू प्रस्तुत गर्न प्रयोग गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: These are thumbnails of slides, which trainers can use to present the points in the cell on the right.
rows.note: Proposed recurring term: thumbnail = लघुचित्र; glossary review pending.

rows.en: These entries include definitions, key concepts, and knowledge to guide the discussion.
rows.ne: यी प्रविष्टिहरूमा छलफललाई दिशा दिन परिभाषा, मुख्य अवधारणा र जानकारी समावेश छन्।
rows.bt: These entries include definitions, key concepts and information to guide the discussion.

rows.en: Facilitators should familiarize themselves with these and ensure that the main points are covered, checking that they are raised by participants in discussions or presenting the points themselves.
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्ताले यी विषयहरूसँग परिचित हुनु र छलफलमा सहभागीहरूले मुख्य बुँदाहरू उठाएका छन् कि छैनन् भनी जाँच गरेर वा आफैँ ती बुँदाहरू प्रस्तुत गरेर मुख्य बुँदाहरू समेटिएको सुनिश्चित गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: It is appropriate for the facilitator to be familiar with these topics and to ensure that the main points are covered by checking whether participants have raised the main points in the discussion or by presenting those points themselves.
rows.note: The back-translation makes both recommendations mandatory ('must'), whereas the source uses 'should'. The revision expresses recommendation rather than obligation.

rows.bt: These thumbnails include activity-related instructions for participants.

rows.bt: These thumbnails include guidance on the group discussion that takes place after the activity.

rows.bt: These boxes include additional guidance and suggestions related to facilitation.

rows.en: In preparing for a workshop, facilitators should choose which topics and which learning activities they will facilitate, considering participants´ training needs and time available for the workshop.
rows.ne: कार्यशालाको तयारी गर्दा सहजीकरणकर्ताले सहभागीहरूको तालिम आवश्यकता र कार्यशालाका लागि उपलब्ध समयलाई ध्यानमा राखी आफूले कुन विषयहरू र कुन सिकाइ गतिविधिहरूको सहजीकरण गर्ने हो भन्ने छनोट गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: When preparing for the workshop, it is appropriate for the facilitator to select which topics and which learning activities they will facilitate, taking into account the participants' training needs and the time available for the workshop.
rows.note: Uses proposed recurring terms learning activity = सिकाइ गतिविधि and facilitation = सहजीकरण; glossary review pending. The back-translation changes 'should choose' to 'must select'. The revision retains the recommendation and both considerations: participants' training needs and available workshop time.

rows.en: Key messages
rows.ne: मुख्य सन्देशहरू
rows.bt: Key messages

rows.en: Repetition of content in different forms such as through exercises and discussions can contribute to participant learning.
rows.ne: अभ्यास र छलफलजस्ता विभिन्न माध्यमबाट विषयवस्तु दोहोर्‍याउँदा सहभागीहरूको सिकाइमा योगदान पुग्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: Repeating the subject matter through various means, such as exercises and discussions, can contribute to participants' learning.

rows.en: This is reflected in learning objectives that in some cases span multiple modules.
rows.ne: यो कुरा सिकाइ उद्देश्यहरूमा प्रतिबिम्बित हुन्छ, जुन केही अवस्थामा एकभन्दा बढी मोड्युलमा समेटिएका हुन्छन्।
rows.bt: This is reflected in the learning objectives, which in some cases are covered in more than one module.
rows.note: Uses proposed recurring term module = मोड्युल; glossary review pending.

rows.en: Facilitators can further integrate repetition into workshops by weaving the key messages below into plenary discussions and discussions following exercises where appropriate.
rows.ne: सहजीकरणकर्ताले उपयुक्त अवस्थामा तलका मुख्य सन्देशहरूलाई सबै सहभागी सम्मिलित छलफलमा र अभ्यासपछि हुने छलफलमा समेटेर कार्यशालामा विषयवस्तुको पुनरावृत्तिलाई अझ समावेश गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: The facilitator can further incorporate repetition of the subject matter into the workshop by including the following key messages, where appropriate, in discussions involving all participants and in discussions after exercises.

rows.en: • Coordination across sectors and organizations is essential. Organizations implementing MHPSS have a responsibility to participate in MHPSS coordination efforts whether this is done through an MHPSS Technical Working Group or another form of coordination.
rows.ne: • क्षेत्रहरू र संस्थाहरूबीच समन्वय अत्यावश्यक छ। मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS) कार्यान्वयन गर्ने संस्थाहरूको जिम्मेवारी MHPSS समन्वय प्रयासहरूमा सहभागी हुनु हो, चाहे यो समन्वय MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (Technical Working Group) मार्फत गरिएको होस् वा अन्य कुनै स्वरूपमा गरिएको होस्।
rows.bt: • Coordination between sectors and organizations is essential. It is the responsibility of organizations implementing mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) to participate in MHPSS coordination efforts, whether this coordination is carried out through an MHPSS Technical Working Group or in any other form.
rows.note: The clinical composite label is reused verbatim from the supplied unreviewed T001 candidate; no clinical validation is implied. The source describes coordination as 'essential'; the Nepali and back-translation make it 'mandatory'. The revision preserves necessity without adding a mandatory requirement. Organizations' responsibility to participate remains unchanged.

rows.en: • MHPSS activities are those activities that have a specific aim of improving the mental health and psychosocial wellbeing of the target population. Activities and services that do not have a specific aim of improving mental health and psychosocial wellbeing are not considered MHPSS activities, even if the impact of the service is positive (e.g., cash assistance may alleviate stress but is not an MHPSS activity unless it has been designed with an MHPSS-focused component). Nonetheless, activities that are not MHPSS-specific can be delivered in such a way that they include MHPSS considerations (see MSP Activity 3.1). Cash assistance and livelihood programs, for example, could take steps to ensure inclusion of and access for persons with mental health conditions.
rows.ne: • लक्षित जनसङ्ख्याको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक सुस्वास्थ्यमा सुधार ल्याउने विशिष्ट उद्देश्य भएका गतिविधिहरू नै MHPSS गतिविधिहरू हुन्। मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक सुस्वास्थ्यमा सुधार ल्याउने विशिष्ट उद्देश्य नभएका गतिविधि तथा सेवाहरूलाई MHPSS गतिविधिहरू मानिँदैन, सेवाको प्रभाव सकारात्मक भए पनि (उदाहरणका लागि, नगद सहायताले तनाव कम गर्न सक्छ, तर MHPSS मा केन्द्रित घटक समावेश गरेर तयार गरिएको नभएसम्म यो MHPSS गतिविधि होइन)। तैपनि, MHPSS का लागि विशिष्ट नभएका गतिविधिहरू पनि MHPSS सम्बन्धी पक्षहरू समेटिने गरी सञ्चालन गर्न सकिन्छ (MSP गतिविधि 3.1 हेर्नुहोस्।)। उदाहरणका लागि, नगद सहायता र जीविकोपार्जनका कार्यक्रमहरूले मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्थाहरू भएका व्यक्तिहरूको समावेशिता र तिनको पहुँच सुनिश्चित गर्न कदम चाल्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: • MHPSS activities are those activities that have the specific objective of improving the mental health and psychosocial well-being of the target population. Activities and services that do not have the specific objective of improving mental health and psychosocial well-being are not considered MHPSS activities, even if the effect of the service is positive (for example, cash assistance can reduce stress, but unless it is designed to include a component focused on MHPSS, it is not an MHPSS activity). Nevertheless, activities that are not specific to MHPSS can also be carried out in a way that incorporates aspects related to MHPSS (see MSP activity 3.1). For example, cash assistance and livelihood programmes can take steps to ensure the inclusion of persons with mental health conditions and their access.
rows.note: Unvalidated practitioner draft preserving the specific-aim requirement, the exclusion despite positive effects, the cash-assistance condition and the possibility of inclusive programme delivery.

rows.en: • MHPSS includes a broad range of activities, not limited to specialized services provided by psychiatrists or psychologists. There are insufficient numbers of mental health specialists to be able to rely on specialists alone. Training and supervising non—specialists is therefore needed. Integration of MHPSS, including MHPSS activities delivered by trained and supervised non-specialists such as general health staff or community workers, is necessary to be able to scale up services to larger numbers of people.
rows.ne: • MHPSS ले गतिविधिहरूको फराकिलो दायरा समेट्छ र यो मनोचिकित्सकहरू वा मनोवैज्ञानिकहरूबाट प्रदान गरिने विशेषीकृत सेवाहरूमा मात्र सीमित छैन। विशेषज्ञहरूमा मात्र भर पर्न सकिने गरी पर्याप्त सङ्ख्यामा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञहरू छैनन्। त्यसैले गैर-विशेषज्ञहरूलाई तालिम दिनु र तिनको सुपरिवेक्षण गर्नु आवश्यक छ। अझ धेरै मानिसहरूसम्म सेवाहरू विस्तार गर्ने क्षमता हासिल गर्न, सामान्य स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा समुदायका कार्यकर्ता जस्ता तालिमप्राप्त तथा सुपरिवेक्षणमा रहेका गैर-विशेषज्ञहरूले सञ्चालन गर्ने MHPSS गतिविधिहरू समेत समेटेर MHPSS को एकीकरण गर्नु आवश्यक छ।
rows.bt: • MHPSS encompasses a broad range of activities and is not limited only to specialized services provided by psychiatrists or psychologists. There are not enough mental health specialists to be able to rely only on specialists. Therefore, it is necessary to train non-specialists and supervise them. To gain the capacity to extend services to more people, it is necessary to integrate MHPSS, including MHPSS activities carried out by trained and supervised non-specialists such as general health workers or community workers.
rows.note: Unvalidated practitioner draft preserving the distinction between professional groups, the insufficiency of specialist numbers and the stated necessity of training, supervision and integration for service expansion. Term annotations omit general health and mental health labels occurring only within more specific expressions; the Nepali wording is unchanged.

rows.en: • All sectors can contribute to integrating and strengthening MHPSS in a humanitarian response as part of their mandate. MHPSS does not “belong” to any one sector.
rows.ne: • सबै क्षेत्रले आफ्नो कार्यादेशअन्तर्गत मानवीय प्रतिकार्यमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न र सुदृढ बनाउन योगदान दिन सक्छन्। MHPSS कुनै एक क्षेत्रको मात्र होइन।
rows.bt: • All sectors can contribute to integrating and strengthening MHPSS in humanitarian response within their mandates. MHPSS does not belong to only one sector.

rows.en: • The MSP operationalizes existing MHPSS activities. It is not a new MHPSS approach but rather a package designed to facilitate the work of actors to integrate or strengthen MHPSS in their sectors. It is designed to make it easier for actors to do this work.
rows.ne: • MSP ले विद्यमान MHPSS गतिविधिहरूलाई कार्यान्वयनयोग्य बनाउँछ। यो MHPSS को नयाँ पद्धति होइन, बरु सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूका लागि आआफ्ना क्षेत्रमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने वा सुदृढ बनाउने काममा सहजीकरण गर्न तयार गरिएको प्याकेज हो। सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूलाई यो काम गर्न सजिलो होस् भनेर यसको तर्जुमा गरिएको हो।
rows.bt: • The MSP makes existing MHPSS activities implementable. It is not a new approach to MHPSS, but rather a package prepared to facilitate the work of relevant parties in integrating or strengthening MHPSS in their respective sectors. It has been designed to make it easier for relevant parties to do this work.
rows.note: Uses proposed recurring term facilitation = सहजीकरण; glossary review pending. The original Nepali and back-translation suggest that MSP itself puts activities into implementation. The revision preserves the enabling sense of 'operationalizes' without assigning implementation to the package itself. The technical rendering of 'operationalizes' remains pending review. The back-translation changes the MSP's role from operationalizing existing MHPSS activities to making them implementable, expressing implementation readiness rather than making the activities operational.
